name: Eastern North Carolina Natural Gas system
monitor_reason: length (and class): the only length is EIA's 72 mi, Aug 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet row 248, single origin, intrastate NC, completed 2002-08, 6 and 12 inch. Independent coverage describes a mixed build of about 140 mi transmission plus 75 mi distribution in the first phase and 600+ mi overall. No source separates the 72 mi transmission trunk, so a sourced length for a transmission row cannot be stated.
researcher_notes: No existing GEM row matches (checked roster for Carolina, Piedmont, PSNC, Pine Needle; only Carolina Gas Transmission P3221/P4381/P4382/P4420 in SC, unrelated). Eastern North Carolina Natural Gas Co was a joint venture of the Albemarle Pamlico Economic Development Corp and Progress Energy, built 2001 to 2004 with state bond funds, bought by Piedmont Natural Gas in 2003 (Piedmont filing and trade press confirm the system exists and the ownership). It is largely a local distribution build to serve 14 counties, so it likely falls outside transmission scope. Not found: any document giving the length of the transmission trunk alone, or a state regulator filing. Revisit if the North Carolina Utilities Commission transmission map shows a distinct trunk. The 72 mi entry may be one project slice of the larger system. The MckimCreed page returned 403 and was not cited.
